articles.title: SpaceX's Nasdaq 100 inclusion comes with a historical warning
articles.snippet: The largest IPO ever enters the Nasdaq 100. Previous additions like Palantir and Strategy saw volatility after the index inclusion rather than the start of new rallies.

articles.title: Crypto bounces back from the brink as altcoin optimism returns despite pockets of weakness
articles.snippet: BTC holds at $62,800 after last week's brush with $58,000, while LIT surges 50% and the Altcoin Season indicator hits its highest reading in three months.

articles.title: Americans traded $571 million on Polymarket politic bets despite U.S. ban
articles.snippet: U.S.-linked wallets traded $571 million in political contracts over the past year, more than any other country, even though the platform legally cannot serve them. The money leans toward the foreign-conflict markets U.S. venues do not list.

articles.title: Thousands of crypto wallets at risk from ‘Ill Bloom’ vulnerability: Coinspect
articles.snippet: Thousands of crypto wallets across multiple blockchains could be vulnerable due to weak recovery phrase generation.

articles.title: Bitcoin to $53K? Exchange Deposits Jump as Analysts Warn of Increased Volatility
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bounced back above $60,000 this week, but increased volatility might be on the way as crypto deposits to exchanges spike.
